paper_title: Solar neutrino limit on axions and keV-mass bosons
notes: Solar neutrino (SNO) energy-loss bound. Main axion-photon result g_agamma < 7e-10 GeV^-1 from Primakoff production, a mass-independent flat limit applying to sub-keV axion masses (solar core T ~1 keV). Encoded as horizontal line spanning ~1 meV to ~1 keV. Paper also derives boson-electron Yukawa limits (PS 2.8e-11, S 2.4e-13, V 1.7e-13), but the primary/cleanest headline result is the axion-photon coupling.
